text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they learn from unfair data, which may lead to unfair treatment of certain groups. To prevent this, we need fairness in the way AI makes decisions. Privacy is also a major concern, because AI often uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it carefully. Transparency means people should understand how AI works and why it makes certain choices. Finally, responsible AI development requires governments, companies, and researchers to work together and follow clear rules. By focusing on these values, we can build AI that is safe, fair, and helpful for everyone.
